finalText:
**Fixed. Build now exits clean with 0 errors.**

The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js` — `resolveConfig` referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`, which crashed the link stage every time.

I changed it to fall back properly: `maxRetries: env.retries || DEFAULTS.maxRetries`, with a new `maxRetries: 3` default. Build now finishes with 3 warnings, 0 errors — the warnings are just noise about a deprecated crypto call, an unused export, and a circular import, none of which block the build.
